n: ACMI Creative Writing Using Twine unit
t: A Year 9 and 10 unit where students write interactive fiction in Twine.
steps: Find the Creative Writing Using Twine unit on the ACMI site.
Choose the interactive fiction texts students will play.
Test Twine in a browser or download it for each student device.
Plan where students will save their story files.
Teach second-person narration with a short example.
Schedule the 4 to 5 weeks of 50 minute lessons.
